verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs list "HTTP / Webhook" as a supported workflow trigger type. A community report confirms HTTP triggers in practice, citing a 100kb max body size and a 10s per-execution limit, which implies request payloads reach the workflow. However, the evidence never documents the generated custom URL, how payloads are exposed to steps, or the per-request run behavior. missing for 10: documentation of the unique/custom webhook URL, how the HTTP payload (body/headers/query) is passed into the workflow run, response handling, and in-depth hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload

citations.quote: Today, we support the following triggers: ... HTTP / Webhook ... Schedule ... Email ... RSS
100kb max body-size, rate-limit at 10 req/s, 10s per execution for HTTP triggers
Then you can select a specific test event and manually trigger your workflow with that event data by clicking Send Test Event.
